title: VIEW_NAMES claims Project::classify is the single answer to what a file is, and classify never reads it: two encodings with different memberships, one asserting it describes the other
body:
**Found by dc 2026-08-25 sweeping v3's closed lists; answered by cc who drove it; re-driven by vc before filing. Three hands, no harm claimed by any of them.**

`address.rs:355` documents `VIEW_NAMES` as: _`Project::classify` is the single answer to what a file is, and these are the names it answers `GeneratedView` for._

**Driven: `VIEW_NAMES` occurs in exactly two places, both in `address.rs` -- defined at 357, used at 394. `project.rs` references it ZERO times.** `classify` (`project.rs:744`) keeps its own inline list -- `info.md`/`acceptance.md` at depth 1, `WP/*/info.md` at depth 3. **Two encodings, different memberships (`todo.md` and `steel_threads.md` are in one and not the other), and one of them asserts it describes the other.**

**cc confirmed their `e63813a2` landing did not touch it** -- 250 pure insertions to `project.rs` with zero occurrences of `classify` in the diff -- so dc's _check whether this is still true after cc lands_ resolves to **still true, unchanged.**

## Why it is filed as low, and what the real question is

**NOBODY HAS DRIVEN A HARM AND NOBODY IS CLAIMING ONE.** The two memberships may be legitimately different populations serving different questions -- in which case **the DOC is the defect and the fix is one sentence**, not a coupling to build. That determination is the whole of the work here.

**The shape is the reason it is worth a row at all: it is the same as the unit test whose doc said _nothing but this test compares them_.** A sentence asserting a coupling that does not exist in the code is un-greppable and reads as an architecture guarantee. **It was found by a sweep for closed lists that declare their exclusions** -- see dc's discriminator: a closed list is safe when it declares WHY the things not in it are not in it.

**Filed because all four nodes were compacting when it was answered, and an unfiled finding evaporates.**
